gates.reason: The paper's Table 5 numbers come from an unpublished random re-split of WLASL, with no split files, seed or stratification rule, and with self-contradictory proportions ('85:15' and '70/15/15'). Several model components are also under-specified: which frames the key-frame Euclidean-distance threshold compares (Algorithm 1), the YOLOv3 normalisation (weights, training data for the two hand anchor boxes, how boxes transform coordinates), macro vs per-instance aggregation, and checkpoint selection. Pose extraction uses the proprietary macOS Apple Vision API, and Apple Vision poses are published (by SPOTER) only for WLASL100. Any run would use invented choices for all four targets, so it cannot yield a comparable produced value.
evidence: Section 5: 'The datasets were split in the ratio of 85:15, out of which 15% of the dataset was used for testing and from 85%, 70% was used for training, 15% for validating, and the remaining 15% for testing.'
Section 6: 'We tested the model after training it using a fixed dataset split of 15%.'
Section 3.2 / Algorithm 1: threshold Th = mu + sigma of histogram differences, compared with an Euclidean distance Ed whose operands are not defined.
Section 3.5: YOLOv3 anchor-box normalisation with no weights, training data or detector configuration.
Section 6: 'standard pose estimation algorithm from apple vision API'.
Table 5 caption 'macro' vs Section 6 'top 1 class accuracy'.
Source search found no code, splits or supplements.
